newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: MobileOne switches on mobile phone, paging network.
newsitem.headline: MobileOne switches on mobile phone, paging network.

text.p: Singapore's second cellular telephone and paging company turned on its networks on Tuesday in preparation for their official launch on April 1, 1997.

Speaking at a switching on ceremony, Singapore minister of state for Trade and Industry and Communications Goh Chee Wee said the early activation of the network would allow MobileOne to test and fine tune its system before it was opened to commercial clients.
MobileOne is a consortium of Keppel Corp and Singapore Press Holdings, which each own 35 percent, and Britain's Cable and Wireless and HongKong Telecommunications, which both hold 15 percent each.
